attchmntText: Molbio Diagnostics Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of Earnings Call with analysts and investors for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Molbio Diagnostics Limited filed a transcript of the earnings call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, held on November 05, 2026. The company reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR667 crores for H1 FY27, compared to INR680 crores in the prior year period. Export revenue stood at INR120 crores. EBITDA was INR153 crores, representing a 23% margin. Profit after tax was INR60 crores. The company achieved a net cash position as of September 2026, reversing a net debt of INR57 crores in March 2026. Management cited a one-month delay in government rate contract renewal as the primary reason for the revenue dip. New product launches including Trueamp, Truecyte, and Truepoc are in validation. Veterinary applications for X-rays and Truenat assays are also in development.

attchmntText: Molbio Diagnostics Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Molbio Diagnostics Limited submitted newspaper advertisements for its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in the Financial Express and Tarun Bharat on November 07, 2026. The company is listed on BSE under script code 544866 and on NSE under symbol MOLBIO. The intimation was sent to both exchanges on November 09, 2026. The document also contains unrelated news clippings in Marathi regarding other entities and events, which are not part of this corporate filing. The core action is the disclosure of financial results via newspaper publication in compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations.
